cogen.title: Exothermic Co-Generation
cogen.desc: Serpentinization is a violently exothermic reaction. By routing the returning supercritical fluids through surface heat exchangers, we strip the thermal energy (ΔH) before separation, driving Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) turbines to power the entire site.
cogen.step1_desc: High-volume rock hydration releases extreme thermal energy (>270°C) into the returning extraction fluid mixture.
cogen.step2_desc: Fluids pass through the primary HX unit, stripping the heat into a closed-loop secondary working fluid before chemical separation.
cogen.step3_desc: Organic Rankine Cycle turbines convert the heat into zero-emission electricity to power AI robotics and compression systems.

ai.title: Pioneering with AI & Robotics
ai.desc: The realization of the Lithospheric Reactor is contingent upon resolving substantial geochemical and engineering challenges. GeoHy utilizes an advanced AI technology stack to mitigate HPHT (High-Pressure, High-Temperature) risks and map expansive lattice structures.
ai.inversion_desc: To avoid the 'Serpentinite Trap' (drilling into spent, oxidized rock), our neural networks process massive seismic and gravimetric datasets to identify pristine olivine.
ai.robotics_desc: Serpentinization creates a depleted 'rind' acting as a severe diffusion barrier within the lattice. We deploy AI-driven robotics capable of operating at 270°C to ream the wellbore.
ai.plasma_desc: Conventional mechanical rotary bits exhibit unacceptable wear in ultra-hard ultramafic lithologies. We utilize next-generation contactless directed-energy plasma drilling.

products.title: The Golden Zone Refinery
products.desc1: By targeting depths of 4 to 5 kilometers, we reach extreme hydrostatic pressures (50-80 MPa). The injected H2O and CO2 transition into a fiercely supercritical state with near-zero surface tension.
products.desc2: At 270°C, the natural Awaruite (Ni3Fe) and Magnetite catalysts trigger Fischer-Tropsch Type (FTT) synthesis. We don't just extract gas; we manufacture high-density fuels.
products.carbon_desc: Supercritical CO2 reacts with magnesium to form solid Magnesite (MgCO3), ensuring verifiable, permanent carbon-negative operation.
products.gas_desc: A synthetic blend of 75% Hydrogen and 25% Methane. Safely transportable via existing midstream pipelines, burning cleaner in standard gas turbines.
products.oil_desc: Secondary cracking produces stable Paraffins and energy-dense Aromatics (C4 to C12) providing the high-thrust energy requisite for aviation and heavy industry.
